description: This Java source file defines an Android activity that demonstrates the seeking capability of the ValueAnimator class. It includes UI components such as a SeekBar and a Button to control the animation of a drawable shape (a ball). The class manages animation creation, starting, seeking, and drawing logic for the animated object.

classes.name: AnimationSeeking
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating animation seeking feature with a custom inner view.

classes.name: MyAnimationView
classes.description: Custom View class inside AnimationSeeking that manages the animated shape and handles drawing, animation updates, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up layout, and attaches event listeners.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Creates the bounce animation for the ball if it hasn't been created already.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current playtime of the animation to a specified position, enabling seeking.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Creates a new ShapeHolder with a colored oval shape and adds it to the ball list.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the current shape at its specified position.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates during animation and triggers view invalidation for redraw.
